title: Vietnamese Shrimp Rieu Noodle Soup
description: A light and romantic Vietnamese noodle soup filled with flavorful shrimp and rich broth. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Heat the Rieu Paste in a large pot over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
Add the Chicken Broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the Shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes.
Cook the Bun Noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Stir in the Fish Sauce, Soy Sauce, and Brown Sugar (if using).
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ladle the hot broth over the cooked noodles and shrimp.
Garnish with chopped Green Onions and serve immediately.
Serve with lime wedges on the side for added flavor.
